entries.title: Zechariah 2:1
segments: I lifted up my eyes again and looked, and behold! A man with a measuring line in his hand.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:2
segments: Then I said, Where are you going? And he said to me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what [is] its breadth and what is its length.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:3
segments: And behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:4
segments: And he said to him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited, [as] towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle in her midst.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:5
segments: And I, says the LORD, will be to her a wall of fire all around, and will be the glory in her midst.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:6
segments: Ho! Ho! Flee then from the land of the north, says the LORD. For I have scattered you as the four winds of the heavens, says the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:7
segments: Ho! O Zion, escape, you who live with the daughter of Babylon.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:8
segments: For so says the LORD of hosts: He has sent me after glory, to the nations who stripped you; for he who touches you touches the pupil of His eye.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:9
segments: For behold, I will shake My hand over them, and they shall be a prize for their servants. And you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:10
segments: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion. For lo, I come, and I will dwell in your midst, says the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:11
segments: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be My people; and I will dwell in your midst, and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to you.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:12
segments: And the LORD shall possess Judah, His portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

entries.title: Zechariah 2:13
segments: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for He has risen out of His holy dwelling place.
